Fantastic app! However, the complete lack of access outside of the Apple ecosystem is a huge hindrance for many, and a total deal breaker for some. Many of us are unavoidably stuck on Windows PCs at work, for example. Outside of Mac/IOS, there's simply no way to use Things or even view our tasks read-only. We're not expecting a Windows desktop client (fully understand that's not your development core), but a web interface and/or an API is a VERY basic requirement for a cloud based app like this, and would open Things up for purchase by many more people on many more platforms. I would be more than happy to pay extra $$$ for basic access to my tasks via the web interface, and I am certainly not alone in this. Your company could profit enormously from adding this essential feature. 
In all other respects, Things is a great app. Keep up the good work!

title.label: Overall I prefer to Todoist - but not perfect

content.label:
I recently switched to Things 3 (for personal tasks) after using Todoist (for everything) for a couple of years. The main reasons:
- upcoming view (integrated with calendar events) is brilliant
- I use tags for context, & it's easy to filter today's tasks by a particular tag
- tasks that don't get done just roll over into the next day without being highlighted in a separate 'overdue' category 
- it's just generally really clean, well thought out & easy to use.

However I still use Todoist for work (where I use Windows) & there are some things it does really well that I miss:
- integrations with heaps of other apps
- very easy to enter new tasks just by typing, no need to click through complex option menus
- emailing to tasks
- attachments
Etc.

So, I'm torn. But for personal use I'm sticking with Things (for now!)
